verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP webhooks that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. It mentions Auth hooks as Postgres functions at lifecycle points and database triggers. These are developer building blocks for customizing behavior, not an event-subscription webhook capability, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Customize Auth behavior with Postgres functions at key lifecycle points.
